d:
Purane dost, purane kisse aur dher saari masti! Is baar Chef Sanjeev Kapoor mile apne purane dost Maniesh Paul aur unki wife Sanyukta se, jahan baatein sirf khaane tak limited nahi rahi!
Pratap Da Dhaba ke delicious Punjabi food se lekar school days ki yaadon, Maniesh ki shaadi ke kisse aur ghar ki funny complaints tak, iss mulaqat mein hua full-on laughter aur unfiltered gupshup! Aur phir aaya ek interesting challenge — aankhon par patti baandhkar masalon ko pehchaanne ka! Dekhte hain Maniesh apne food knowledge se kitna impress kar paate hain.
